title: inventoryPhotos
body:
## inventoryPhotos

Inventory the camera-recorded metadata a small set of captured field photos declares about itself: JPEG frame width and height, IFD0 camera make, model and orientation code, and the ExifIFD capture wall time with its optional recorded UTC offset. Use it to reconcile photos with field observations in an editable workbook: it publishes a typed inventory.csv (feed it to Calc) and a metadata.json holding each photo's SHA-256, your stable ID and the scoped raw ExifTool observations. A separate independent byte-level reader must agree with ExifTool on every selected tag, and a second fresh ExifTool process must repeat the first. Missing tags stay explicit nulls; filesystem times are never used. It does not write, rotate or strip images, read GPS, faces or thumbnails, decode pixels, or certify when, where or by whom a photo was taken.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- A camera can record a wrong clock, zone or orientation; agreement between ExifTool and the independent reader proves what the file says, not what happened.
- capturedLocal is a wall time without a zone and is not UTC; capturedUtc exists only when the same file records OffsetTimeOriginal.
- Orientation is the stored EXIF code 1-8; the pixels are not rotated.
- Everything outside the nine selected fields, including GPS, is unassessed rather than absent; progressive, multi-image and non-baseline JPEGs are refused.
- A Calc workbook handoff needs at least two photos and at least two present orientation codes.
- An offset of -00:00 means an unknown offset and is refused; +00:00 is a recorded zero offset.

Native binding: `perl exiftool -config "" -json -n -a -G1:4 -e -q -IFD0:Make -IFD0:Model -IFD0:Orientation -ExifIFD:DateTimeOriginal -ExifIFD:OffsetTimeOriginal -File:ImageWidth -File:ImageHeight -File:EncodingProcess -File:BitsPerSample -File:ColorComponents -ExifTool:Warning -ExifTool:Error captured/ID.jpg...`. Output kind: `["text","table"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `photos` | The photos to inventory, in the order you want rows (1 to 16). Order is preserved in inventory.csv and metadata.json. Each photo is captured into the run before ExifTool starts; total size is at most 16MiB. Each entry must be a different source file: the same path, an alias or a hard link is refused (identical bytes in distinct files are allowed and not deduplicated). | `{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":16,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"sha256":{"type":"string","minLength":64,"maxLength":64}}}}` | **required** |
